Square podcast show cover artwork for a weekly French AI news podcast. Characters from reference 1: Hugo (adult man, brown hair, short beard, teal eyes, dark watch on left wrist) and iAstro (child android boy with HUMAN face, black spiky quiff, big black anime eyes, cyan dot on temple, cyan heart on white shirt, purple accents, purple studio headphones). Keep their exact faces; neutral year-round clothing. HEAD PERFECTLY UPRIGHT: vertical face axis, horizontal eye line, absolutely no head tilt to either side (this is critical, the previous drawings tilted the head to the left). Both look at the viewer, happy and confident. Expressive manga ink and watercolor style. FOREGROUND (most important): a gorgeous podcast studio desk: two broadcast microphones on arms, glowing warm analog VU meters, a mixing console, a turntable with a vinyl record, both wear headphones. Large, perfectly legible title lettering: "LA SEMAINE iA" (exact casing: lowercase i, uppercase A, with a space between LA and SEMAINE), small subtitle "Le Podcast iA · l'hebdo". No date, no other text, no logos. Strong readable composition at thumbnail size. BACKGROUND: a big studio window on a neo-Tokyo night skyline, neon signs in magenta and cyan, light rain reflections, deep indigo night. On-air light.
